procedures.purpose: Resolve the owning project and load its instructions before substantive action.
steps: Read AI_ENTRYPOINT.json.
Run the repository entry router for every affected path.
Load every resolved project entrypoint, nested AGENTS.md, registry, validator, and stopping rule.
Honor the emitted disposition.

procedures.purpose: Bind work to immutable repository identities.
steps: Resolve each supplied ref with git rev-parse <ref>^{commit}.
Record the exact 40-character commit SHA.
Resolve and record parent and merge-base identities when lineage matters.
Reject abbreviated, missing, or moving refs as final evidence.

procedures.purpose: Execute against committed state rather than conversation or private working state.
steps: Fetch the exact required commits.
Create a detached checkout or worktree at the governing head.
Verify git status --porcelain is empty.
Execute only the repository-declared command.
Write outputs outside the repository or to an ignored path.

procedures.purpose: Provide a clean execution backend when a local room cannot clone or run the repository.
steps: Use the procedure-specific workflow declared by the project entrypoint.
Checkout the exact governing head with full history.
Pass the exact target commit as an explicit workflow input.
Run the same repository gate or validator used by the local backend.
Upload the command-emitted receipt and fingerprint even when the gate fails.
Bind the result to workflow run, job, artifact, governing head, and target commit identities.

procedures.purpose: Determine exact divergence without assuming branch state.
steps: Resolve exact base and head commits.
Compute merge base.
List every changed path and blob identity.
Record ahead and behind counts.
Treat unrelated main advancement separately from candidate lineage.

procedures.purpose: Recover executable evidence from GitHub Actions.
steps: Resolve workflow run and job identities.
Inspect step conclusions and logs.
List artifacts by exact run.
Download the named artifact.
Verify artifact digest and contained receipt identities.

procedures.purpose: Distinguish repository identity from file names and summaries.
steps: Resolve Git blob SHA for committed text identity.
Compute SHA-256 for transported artifact bytes.
Record byte count and member manifest for archives.
Reject name-only or URL-only identity claims.

procedures.purpose: Make execution durable and independently discoverable.
steps: Use the procedure-declared receipt schema.
Bind exact governing and target commits, commands, measurements, artifacts, and disposition.
Commit only after validation when repository publication is authorized.
Preserve workflow artifact identity when repository publication is not authorized.
Record exact starting head and changed paths.
Declare the rollback operation before promotion.
Execute rollback in an isolated branch or worktree.
Verify protected blobs and accepted baseline identities are restored exactly.

procedures.purpose: Turn an admitted repository-governed execution request into one exact-head nonmutating command execution without requiring interactive chat terminal access.
steps: Resolve the separately admitted operation and owning project profile.
Resolve the exact target commit and declared fixed command.
Create or select a disposable clean execution environment permitted by the project profile.
Checkout the target commit detached with full history when lineage is tested.
Verify a clean worktree before execution.
Execute only the declared command with outputs outside the repository or in an ignored disposable path.
Emit environment and command-execution receipts.
Destroy or invalidate the mutable environment after receipt capture.

procedures.purpose: Reexecute the same frozen target and command in a distinct clean environment with no mutable-state reuse.
steps: Create a fresh environment with a distinct environment identity.
Resolve the same exact target commit independently.
Execute the same declared command without builder outputs except immutable declared inputs.
Emit a fresh-verifier command receipt and output digests.

procedures.purpose: Compare builder and fresh-verifier immutable outputs without allowing favorable-result substitution.
steps: Bind builder and fresh-verifier receipt digests.
Compare the declared equality domain byte-for-byte or by the procedure-declared canonical hash.
Emit PASS_EXACT_EQUALITY or FAIL_CLOSED_MISMATCH.
Do not reinterpret mismatches as success.

procedures.purpose: Prove that a disposable environment is no longer relied upon as continuing authority after execution.
steps: Record environment identity and last exact target.
Remove the disposable worktree/container/Codespace when the caller has destruction capability, or mark it explicitly nonauthoritative when physical destruction is outside the caller transport.
Emit a destruction receipt that distinguishes destroyed from merely detached.
Never treat a long-lived environment as canonical scientific custody.
